title: Standard F1b Aussiedoodles
temperament: highly intelligent, and affection-driven dogs that combine the playful drive of an Australian Shepherd with the eager-to-please, low-shedding nature of a Poodle.
cardDesc: Meet Dahlia and Aspen's Standard F1b Aussidoodle litter—smart, energetic, and endlessly affectionate pups with non-shedding, hypoallergenic coats. Inheriting the sharp intelligence of the Australian Shepherd and the eager-to-please nature of the Poodle, these babies will thrive in active homes full of play, learning, and cozy family downtime.
